phases.objective: Make Repository Inventory regeneration a bounded recipe of the existing governed generated-artifact writer while keeping verification read-only and resolving the writer's first-install self-hosting cycle without executing candidate mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.actor: repository inventory verification gate, CI, trusted dispatcher, and governed generated-artifact writer
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository governed work branch has stale Repository Inventory outputs, either under already-trusted Inventory authority or while installing that authority for the first time.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Ordinary stale-only pull requests are delegated to already-trusted writer authority. A first-install authority branch remains read-only, proves deterministic exact-head candidate outputs with the canonical generator unchanged from main, reports bootstrap_pending rather than executing candidate write authority, and requires the generated-output follow-up only after writer authority has become trusted on main.
steps: Checkout the exact candidate head with read-only repository permission.
Run the shared Repository Inventory verification gate from both Repository Inventory and CI.
Generate the three Inventory outputs twice and require identical SHA-256 identities across both passes.
Regenerate the coupled remote MCP write-scope inventory outputs and require its deterministic check to pass.
Regenerate Repository Evaluation outputs after the Inventory fingerprint changes and require evaluation:check to pass with no blocking gaps.
Run the canonical Inventory check and self-test after generation.
If committed Inventory is current, report current and continue normally.

For an ordinary stale-only PR, keep existing fail-closed dispatch rules: same repository, main base, zero-behind freshness, unchanged trusted authority, deterministic exact three-file drift, and trusted writer delegation only.

For a self-hosting authority installation, permit bootstrap_pending only on pull_request or exact-head workflow_dispatch for a governed non-protected branch whose remote head still equals the expected SHA.
Require current main to be an ancestor of the exact candidate and require scripts/repository-inventory.mjs, package.json, and package-lock.json to be byte-unchanged from trusted main.

Require the authority installation to include the governed writer workflow, Inventory verifier, Inventory autofix dispatcher, generated-artifact maintenance tool, and repository-inventory-governed-regeneration E2E contract.
Require the canonical Inventory generator alone to dirty exactly docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, and docs/repository-inventory.md and no other worktree path.

For a coupled generated-artifact recovery, permit only the two remote MCP write-scope outputs, the three Repository Evaluation outputs, and this E2E contract in addition to the canonical Inventory outputs; runtime source, dependencies, migrations, grants, and protected refs remain unchanged.
Publish bootstrap_pending as read-only evidence from Repository Inventory or CI; do not commit, push, dispatch candidate write code, mutate a protected branch, or force-push.

After source authority merges to main, create a non-protected generated-output work branch from trusted main, invoke repository_inventory_refresh through the trusted writer, and verify the resulting exact head before the generated-output PR is merged.

For a failed push-triggered Inventory run on exact main, classify only the live main SHA, reject stale event heads, and route recovery into chore/repository-inventory-main-sync-<sha12> rather than mutating main.

For a workflow_dispatch convergence request, require create_from_main=true, source_main_sha equal to expected_head_sha, the governed branch namespace, and live main equality before creating the branch.
If the convergence branch already exists, require its remote head to equal the exact source main SHA; refuse branch reuse with a different head.
assertions: Repository Inventory and CI use one shared read-only verification gate for currentness and self-hosting bootstrap decisions.
The shared gate performs two generation passes and compares SHA-256 identities before claiming deterministic_generation_verified.
Repository Inventory pull-request verification has contents read only and performs no git push.
Repository Inventory regeneration writes exactly docs/repository-inventory.json, docs/repository-inventory-summary.json, and docs/repository-inventory.md.
A coupled write-scope refresh writes only http-generic-api/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.generated.json and docs/remote-mcp-write-scope-inventory.md.
Repository Evaluation outputs are regenerated from the current Inventory fingerprint and evaluation:check passes with no blocking gaps.

The self-hosting bootstrap may report bootstrap_pending on pull_request or workflow_dispatch, and on push only when the same-repository target is a governed non-protected work branch; push on main or Production remains fail-closed.
workflow_dispatch bootstrap_pending requires a governed non-protected branch and remote exact-head equality.
bootstrap_pending requires the canonical Inventory generator and package contract to be unchanged from trusted main.
bootstrap_pending requires behind_by zero and an exact three-output dirty set with no additional worktree changes.
bootstrap_pending is evidence only: repository_mutation, protected_branch_mutation, and force_push remain false.
Candidate-modified generated-artifact mutation authority is never executed before it is trusted on main.
The ordinary automatic dispatcher still refuses candidate-modified mutation authority and requires its trusted control surface to match main.
The dispatcher has actions write only in the delegation job and never receives contents write permission.
The governed writer requires an exact expected_head_sha and typed confirmation, rejects main and Production, and never force-pushes.
The post-merge bootstrap uses a non-protected work branch; main and Production remain outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets.
Generated-artifact verification routes repository_inventory_refresh to Repository Inventory rather than a generic verifier.
Push-triggered and workflow_dispatch-triggered recovery use the same exact-head and fail-closed source identity contract.
A governed work-branch push may publish bootstrap evidence only with repository identity, main-base identity, and a non-protected governed branch; protected-ref pushes remain blocked.

Work Map Integration may retain the broad .github/workflows/** trigger required by pipeline connectivity, but its currentness and repair path must classify pull-request changes and remain inactive for unrelated generated-artifact or inventory changes.
Main convergence creates only a non-protected branch and never grants the dispatcher contents write authority.
The writer refuses protected targets, requires typed confirmation, and does not merge or publish a Production change.
Production deployment, database mutation, direct protected-ref mutation, and secret publication are outside this feature.

phases.objective: Observe the first trusted post-merge Repository Inventory generated-output follow-up on a non-protected work branch, including push-run recovery, branch collision refusal, and canonical exact-head verification evidence.
blockers: Current main has deterministic Repository Inventory drift and requires the first trusted post-merge generated-output convergence before operational can be claimed.

phases.objective: Exercise stale SHA, main drift, changed generator/package contract, changed authority surface, nondeterministic generation, dirty-set escape, no-op, dispatch failure, and post-push readback mismatch paths.
Use the first post-merge generated-output work branch as the bounded canary for repository_inventory_refresh.
Keep main and Production outside direct generated-artifact mutation targets while allowing trusted merged authority to govern ordinary work branches.
